title: Normalise a header row
description: A header row is a comma-separated list of column names. Upper-case every name and return the names joined again with commas. Scan from left to right and report the first problem as an error: a name that is empty gives "empty header at position N" (N counts from 1), and a name that equals an earlier name after upper-casing gives "duplicate header: NAME" with the upper-cased name. For each position the emptiness check comes before the duplicate check. An empty row is a single empty name, so it is an error at position 1.
notes: Needs an invariant (the set of names seen so far) and an ordered error rule. Error precedence: left to right, empty before duplicate.
